context.description: Die lernende Person kann Brüche in endliche oder periodische Dezimalbrüche umwandeln, umgekehrt endliche und einfache periodische Dezimalbrüche als Brüche darstellen und Darstellungswechsel begründet wählen.
context.titleEn: Convert between fractions and decimal numbers
context.descriptionEn: The learner can convert fractions into terminating or repeating decimals, represent terminating and simple repeating decimals as fractions, and justify chosen representation changes.
context.subject: mathematik

originalReason: Three quarters equals 0.75, separately one third is recurring 0.333..., 0.2=2/10=1/5 and recurring 0.666...=6/9=2/3. One third plus two thirds is one and 0.7 exceeds 0.68. The phrase fractions are often more precise is read as a comparison with rounded decimals, not an exclusive mathematical claim.
